title: Crispy Lemon Chicken Cutlets
summary: Thin chicken cutlets in a crunchy panko crust, pan-fried and finished with a buttery lemon and parsley sauce. Dinner in under 40 minutes.

creator.bio: Sample creator. Italian home cooking with pantry staples, a good pan and not much fuss.

steps.instruction: Halve each chicken breast horizontally into thin cutlets and season both sides with salt and pepper.
success_cues: Cutlets are an even thickness, about 1/2 inch
warnings: Sharp knife: curl your fingertips under and keep the board steady on a damp towel.
Raw chicken: wash hands, board and knife after handling, and keep it away from ready-to-eat food. Check the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer; color alone is not a reliable sign.

steps.instruction: Set up three plates: flour, beaten egg and panko. Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then press firmly into the panko.
success_cues: Crumbs cover the cutlet completely with no bare patches
warnings: Wash hands after breading; the egg and flour plates have touched raw chicken, so discard leftovers.

steps.instruction: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Fry the cutlets in batches, 3 to 4 minutes per side, without crowding the pan.
success_cues: Crust is deep golden and crisp on both sides
A thermometer in the thickest cutlet reads 165°F (74°C)
warnings: Hot oil can spit; add food away from your body and keep the handle turned inward.
Raw chicken: wash hands, board and knife after handling, and keep it away from ready-to-eat food. Check the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer; color alone is not a reliable sign.
steps.creator_note: Leave them alone while they fry. Moving them knocks the crust off.

steps.instruction: Move the cutlets to a rack. Pour off most of the oil, lower the heat and melt the butter with the lemon juice, swirling for 30 seconds.
success_cues: Butter foams and turns slightly cloudy with the lemon
warnings: The pan is still hot; tilt it away from you when pouring off oil.

steps.instruction: Spoon the lemon butter over the cutlets, scatter parsley if using and serve right away.
success_cues: Crust stays crisp under the sauce

creator_notes: Pound the cutlets thinner if your breasts are very thick; they cook more evenly.
dietary_warnings: Contains wheat (flour, panko), egg and milk (butter).
